name: basium
description: Basium, the Mercurian angel hero: an angel knight in polished white-and-silver plate armour with gold trim and blue gems, a golden helm with small white wings and a gold crest, short blonde hair, a blue tabard hanging from a gold belt, huge white feathered wings spread from his back, and a long steel longsword with a gold crossguard held upright before his chest, gripped by the end of its hilt in his RIGHT hand
hands: the longsword's hilt stays in his right hand, whose forearm crosses the chest from the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also grips the hilt just above it, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the hilt, the longsword is raised straight up above the head with its tip pointing at the sky, the white wings lifting
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the sword hand behind the head and the blade hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly, the white wings half spread
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the sword arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the longsword is level, pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist, the wings sweeping back
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the longsword slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance, the white wings flared behind him
strike.5: follow-through: the blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair trailing back, the white wings still spread
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the longsword comes back up on the near side toward its upright ready angle, the left hand reaching for the hilt, the wings folding back

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (sword arm thrown up and out to the left with the longsword pointing up, the empty left fist flung out to the right), the white wings jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the longsword held upright in front of the body, the empty left fist still held out, the wings ruffled

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, sword arm flung up with the longsword, the empty left fist drooping, the wings sagging
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the longsword lowering, the white wings drooping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the longsword's tip resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging, the wings drooping to the ground
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the longsword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white wings crumpling
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the winged helm on his head; the longsword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the white wings spread flat under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white wings settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back on his spread white wings, eyes closed, the longsword on the ground beside him
